_comment: Hosts and ids the forbidden-string gate lets through, each with the reason. Add nothing here without a reason.

hosts.reason: Placeholder default PF_URL in server/src/config.js and .env.example. Replace it with your own PingFederate host in your local .env; never commit a real host.
Placeholder default ACME_PF_URL in server/src/config.js and .env.example. Replace it with your own outside-company PingFederate host in your local .env.

Comment in deploy/docker-compose.yml only (live-PF wiring, PR #20): documents that extra_hosts resolves the host's dev-loopback origin to the host gateway so the container can reach the owner's local PingFederate. No config default uses it; the real PF_URL comes from the untracked .env.

deploy/se/jwks-curator.yaml: the SE k8s Ingress host for the owner-run resource-as JWKS/curator deployment (commit 764b556). SE manifests name the real SE host by design; nothing in app config defaults to it.
